verdict.rationale: Elastic's own docs say it offers cost-efficient retention with tiered storage, which covers the retention-tier half of the story at a high level. Nothing in the pack documents trace or log sampling controls, and there are no details on how developers configure retention policies. Missing for 10: documented trace/log sampling configuration (head/tail sampling rates), concrete retention-tier/lifecycle configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can control trace/log sampling and retention tiers to manage data volume deliberately

citations.quote: offers scalable, cost-efficient data retention with tiered storage
